/about: About Vatulé Luxury at it’s best! Vatulé is a beachfront property located on the exclusive gated community of La Punta Estates. This luxury villa vacation rental is located on the same latitude as Hawaii offering near perfect weather all year. Vatulé is the ideal property for a family gathering, a friend’s getaway, relaxing and playing golf, or for a corporate retreat. This luxury villa vacation rental features spectacular indoor/outdoor spaces and will accommodate twenty-two guests very comfortably. Vatulé is designed for 5 couples and their children. It has five king suites all with ocean views and private entrances. Each king suite is equipped with its own sonos sound system, Netflix and Apple TV. In addition, there is a 12 bed bunk room and an available staff house upon request. The villa was designed to merge from inside to outside seamlessly and the views are breathtaking of the ocean, mountains and golf course. The flow of fresh ocean breezes and natural sunlight are found in the numerous windows through this luxury villa rental all overlooking the ocean. The interior of Vatulé features understated elegance with several lounge areas decorated with designer furnishings, stained wood, and neutral-relaxing textures. Raw exposed wood beams and stone are accented throughout the villa. A Palapa roofing and swaying palm trees provide shade and protection from the sun. A five-star gourmet kitchen includes your private chef, waiter, and bartender who will pamper and service you and your guests during your stay at this luxury vacation rental in Punta Mita. Three daily meals will be enjoyed in either the two formal dining areas or Alfresco, overlooking the pool and ocean. In the evening relax in the Media Room watching your favorite movie. During the day you and your guests will enjoy the infinity pool, hot tub, and sun loungers. In the evening relax at the fire pit and watch spectacular sunsets. Vatulé features Full Staff Services including two housekeepers on site each day. There is Shuttle Service to help make your stay at Vatulé even more comfortable. The villa provides a six seater golf cart and 6 bikes for a short drive to the tennis courts, golf courses and three beach clubs all on the resorts’ gated property of the Four Seasons Resort. Take a day trip into Puerto Vallarta just an hour drive down the coast and enjoy Boutique Shops and the famous Malecon. Book your stay at Vatulé Your dream vacation awaits Book now
